author: deployedmind
text:
Business Insider reports that Sergey Brin pushed to monitor Google employees as they coded, believing their work could help improve Gemini through reinforcement learning.

It also says he killed Jeff Dean’s "Frozen" chip project.

author: deployedmind
text: Brin reportedly told Google DeepMind employees that working 60 hours a week was the "sweet spot" for productivity. One former manager told employees to ignore the memo. Brin now works closely with Koray Kavukcuoglu.

author: deployedmind
text:
More details about the tension inside Google DeepMind has long centred on its identity: should it be a 10-year research bet working on things that benefit humanity or a lab fighting rivals on 3–6-month product cycles? 

Now, Demis Hassabis is moving further away from operations.
